summary: Retest covering the new acceptance matrix (AI brand chip overflow fix, section rhythm, hero badge motion, Puppy One logo-free image, marketplace USP redesign, closing CTA primary-button match) plus full regression. Backend signups suite (3/3) and 15 browser check runs across the iteration all pass. The retired marketplace step-tour check (market-step-*/market-price-slider/market-approve-button/market-earned) was removed and replaced by marketplace-usp-section, which verifies the new static USP layout (heading, 4 usp cards with icon+title+body, decorative illustration, market-join-link->#get-started, 2-row desktop / single-column mobile layout, no step tabs or phone mock). Regenerated a fresh Clerk sign-in ticket for jane+clerk_test@example.com (previous one expired) and auth-entry-signed-in now passes again.
